summary: Re-verified the recorded Phase 7 blocker against HEAD (5ea7152c). THE BLOCKER NO LONGER HOLDS, and it was not resolved by either route the prior handoff anticipated. Route (a) -- a bespoke S4 keyed top-level driver -- is ~85% landed by the dependencies: modalExpandBranchesS4Keyed/modalTableauS4Keyed AND a successor ordered pair modalExpandBranchesS4KeyedOrdered/modalTableauS4KeyedOrdered both exist with full processNext fuel inductions. The soundness re-verification the handoff flagged as unverified has been done and its answer inverted the plan: soundness is FALSE for the unordered keyed driver (machine-checked counterexample in CslibTests/S4LoopGuardRegression.lean, documented at FrameCompleteness.lean:4088-4104, two independent defects: birth-key staleness and unrestricted redirect reachability), and TRUE AND PROVED for the ordered driver (modalTableauS4KeyedOrdered_sound, FrameCompleteness.lean:8234, concluding genuine unweakened s4Valid; lean_verify returns an EMPTY axiom list). The repair was scheduling (settled-context: non-minting candidates first, minting only once no non-minting rule can fire) rather than a change to the guard predicate. Route (b) (generalizing RuleApply to thread opaque per-branch state) is moot for closing S4 and partly landed anyway as task 564's RuleApplySt ladder. What remains is a bounded ~580-line port: (1) modalStepBranchS4KeyedOrdered_none_saturated -- PROBED GREEN THIS DISPATCH as a one-liner via modalStepBranchS4KeyedOrdered_eq_none_iff, lake build 876/876 exit 0, then reverted; (2) relocate modalStepBranchS4KeyedOrdered_newExps_eq_map from FrameCompleteness.lean:7869 down into LoopChecking.lean (verified pure move, all deps in S4/Driver.lean and public); (3) modalExpandBranchesS4KeyedOrdered_hintikka (~370-line structural port of the landed unordered analogue, simplified by using the already-bundled S4OrderedFuelInv + modalStepBranchS4KeyedOrdered_preserves_S4OrderedFuelInv as the single step lemma); (4) modalExpandBranchesS4KeyedOrdered_openBranch_initial_mem (~135-line port); (5) modalTableauS4KeyedOrdered_complete plus s4Valid_decides/instDecidableS4Valid mirroring kb5Valid_decides/instDecidableKb5Valid (FrameCompleteness.lean:4069-4082). The seed-state S4OrderedFuelInv witness needed by completeness is already assembled verbatim inside modalTableauS4KeyedOrdered_sound. RECOMMENDATION: do NOT re-block; proceed to /plan with the four-phase shape in the report.
